name: dovebus
description: Real-time map of Autolinee Toscane buses in Tuscany

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage --workspace=server && npm run coverage --workspace=client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=client
scripts.lint: biome lint server client/src client/scripts client/test client/*.ts
scripts.check: biome check server client/src client/scripts client/test client/*.ts
scripts.check:fix: biome check --write server client/src client/scripts client/test client/*.ts
scripts.format: biome format --write server client/src client/scripts client/test client/*.ts
